articles.headline: Drone halts play in Arsenal Carabao Cup game at 4th-tier Fleetwood Town
articles.description: Arsenal's Carabao Cup game at Fleetwood Town was halted for around eight minutes on Tuesday after a drone was spotted above the fourth-tier club's home ground.
